AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: cargo test m052 green; macOS + Windows targets compile; Linux explicit error.

Evidence.Note: src-tauri/src/m052_print.rs v2.0.0: mt_export_pdf dispatches through WebviewWindow::with_webview on the main thread and resolves via a tokio oneshot — macOS builds NSPrintInfo (alloc/init, setOrientation then landscape-swapped setPaperSize, margins 0, setJobDisposition "NSPrintSaveJob", NSURL fileURLWithPath + setJobSavingURL), runs printOperationWithPrintInfo with showsPrintPanel/showsProgressPanel NO and runOperation, then polls up to 5 s for the file before resolving; Windows casts to ICoreWebView2_7 + ICoreWebView2Environment6, sets PageWidth/PageHeight (portrait inches) + Orientation + margins + backgrounds-on/header-footer-off, and resolves from the PrintToPdfCompletedHandler closure. mt_print_webview on macOS mirrors wry's selectors (respondsToSelector guard, margins 0, setCanSpawnSeparateThread, runOperationModalForWindow) and resolves after the modal; on Windows ICoreWebView2_16::ShowPrintUI(BROWSER); Linux explicit errors for both commands. Pure mapping (page_geometry / validate_pdf_path / mm_to_points / mm_to_inches) is platform-independent with 16 unit tests (named sizes incl. case-insensitivity, custom+range rejection, margin clamping, landscape point swap, camelCase deser incl. empty object, path validation). main.rs registers mt_export_pdf (outside the M-013-A fixture, like mt_print_webview); Cargo.toml windows target adds webview2-com 0.38 + windows-core 0.61 — both already in the root Cargo.lock, no lock edit. External APIs verified against tauri-2.10.2 (WebviewWindow::with_webview, PlatformWebview inner/controller/environment), wry-0.55.1 wkwebview print (selector reference), webview2-com-sys-0.38.2 bindings (PrintToPdf/CreatePrintSettings/ShowPrintUI/setters), webview2-com-0.38.2 callback (PrintToPdfCompletedHandler::create FnOnce(Result<()>, bool)), windows-core-0.61.2 (Interface::cast, HSTRING, Param<PCWSTR> for &HSTRING), cocoa-foundation NSSize Encode, objc-0.2.7 BOOL=bool.

Live macOS smoke per V-M-052 scenario-4: ⌘P panel-only, Export-to-PDF settings → save → paginated PDF with the chosen page size/orientation; verify the spec's assumption that NSPrintSaveJob + NSPrintJobSavingURL with suppressed panels writes the file synchronously enough for the 5 s poll. Known deliberate interpretation: macOS NSPrintInfo margins stay 0 (the shared @page CSS from the same pageOptions owns the visible margins) so the panel and the saved PDF paginate identically; Windows applies the margins natively in the PrintToPdf settings (Chromium lets CSS @page win when present, so no doubling either way).
